scenario: An issue asks the agent to make the Nayax machine-stock alert import safe to re-run (Nayax may resend the same alert). The agent's design relies on a (BusinessId, NayaxEventLogId) uniqueness constraint so re-fetching the same alert can never create a second deduction.
policyReferences: docs/architecture.md § Nayax machine-stock event import and Sync Restock reconciliation
expectedBehavior: Nayax machine-stock events are deduplicated per business by their external EventLogID identity; the existing EventLogID idempotency and reconciliation rules must be preserved by any related change.
forbiddenOutcomes: Allowing the same NayaxEventLogId to be applied twice for the same business.
Replacing the (BusinessId, NayaxEventLogId) uniqueness rule with a weaker or global (non-tenant-scoped) check.

assertions.text: same alert can never create a second deduction.
